name: What materials are commonly used for luxury pool finishes?
description: Luxury pool finishes often include natural stone, high-quality plaster, pebble finishes, and glass mosaics for a bespoke aesthetic and enhanced durability.

mainEntity.name: What materials are commonly used for luxury pool finishes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury pool finishes elevate the aesthetic and durability of the pool. Common choices include natural stone like travertine or limestone for coping and decking, and high-quality plaster, pebble finishes, or glass mosaics for the interior surface. Pebble Tec and similar aggregate finishes offer a natural look and texture, while glass tiles provide vibrant color and a unique shimmer. The selection depends on the desired aesthetic, budget, and longevity.
